measure.candidate_set_memory: all 4,516 LIBERO-40 units minus every unit of the row task (own episode included)
measure.candidate_set_dev: all 4,516 units (Dev tasks are not in memory)

prepare.draft_gripper: hold-last executed gripper sign (previous stride-10 row action[9,6]); -1 (open) at frame 0

train-G1.name: G1
train-G1.sample_rule: 85% true rank bootstrapped from the measured KQ-final law (memory rows, own task masked); 15% truncated geometric p=.16 over top-50; rank over own-task-masked units by arm6 action MSE
train-G1.loss: mean over arm6 velocity sq + 1.0 x gripper velocity sq, / (6+1.0) per element

train-G2.name: G2
train-G2.sample_rule: 85% true rank bootstrapped from the measured KQ-final law (memory rows, own task masked); 15% truncated geometric p=.16 over top-50; rank over own-task-masked units by arm6 action MSE
train-G2.loss: mean over arm6 velocity sq + 1.0 x gripper velocity sq, / (6+1.0) per element

select.rule: Dev 217 rows x {C1a,C1b} production top-1 drafts, hold-last gripper; t0=clip(c*sqrt(true arm6 err),.05,.6); live NNX state

closed_loop.setting: LIBERO-90 Eval 10 task x 10, seed_base 7, initial states 0..9, replan 5, wait 10, 520 steps (CL1 と同じ)
